rockArt.reason: The Fallarbor tileset's brown volcanic rock (Routes 113 and 114, Fallarbor Town), Route 115's rock of 2 x 2 cells in the sea and the ash-covered boulder - every one of these metatiles a blocked cell drew flat in the sweep of 2026-10-30; not its trees, its sand or the rock with the hole. Blocked, it stands as a rock band; walked, it stays ground. Local metatile ids.
